guidelineReference: SJA First Aid / major trauma and bleeding
title: Severe abdominal trauma backstage at a concert
setting: Outdoor concert backstage scaffolding. Young male found collapsed with a severe abdominal injury, bleeding heavily, pale, cold, clammy.
verdictExplanation: Severe abdominal injury with large open wound, heavy bleeding, and signs of decompensated shock (pulse 98 bpm, BP 82/52). Sick: call 999, control bleed, and elevate.

history.history: Knocked and fell onto a protruding sharp scaffolding pipe 10 minutes ago
history.injuries: Large open wound to abdomen, heavy bleeding

followUp.question: What is the priority first aid intervention for this severe abdominal trauma?

options.text: Call 999, apply firm pressure dressings over the wound, lie him flat with knees slightly bent, and keep warm
Wash the exposed organs under warm tap water and try to push them back
Apply a tourniquet tightly around his abdomen to stop the bleeding
Force him to walk to the first aid post to get proper equipment

followUp.explanation: Severe abdominal trauma. Call 999 immediately. Apply a firm pressure dressing over the wound. Lie the patient flat with knees slightly bent (reduces abdominal wall tension). Keep warm to treat shock. Never push organs back or use a tourniquet on the abdomen. Never allow walking.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Call 999. Apply pressure dressing, lie flat with knees bent, keep warm.
levelFlags.erNotes: Severe abdominal trauma with hemorrhagic shock (BP 82/52). Control bleed, administer oxygen, keep warm, check BGL, and transfer priority.
